mainText: Hello, Verona! At 5 PM, here is today's balanced dish. We have clear skies and a temperature of 78 degrees at Badger Prairie County Park. The air quality index is at 52, so be mindful of that. It is a New Moon, and if you look to the West near Mount Horeb at 9:08 PM, you can catch the International Space Station traveling toward the Northeast near Home Depot for four minutes. The overnight low will drop to 63 degrees with no rain expected.

Regarding city news, officers were dispatched to the 600 block of Hunter's Cove Way on Wednesday for a burglary in progress where a firearm was discharged, though no injuries were reported. Additionally, the Verona Police Department is currently accepting applications for its free nine-week Citizen Academy program running from September 23 to November 18.

There is plenty to enjoy this week. We have live music at Bailey's Run Vineyard today and at Paddy Mac's tomorrow. Tomorrow, the Dane County Farmers' Market will be set up at the Capitol Square, and this Saturday, Verona will host the Ironman Wisconsin Loop Festival on Main Street.

In our weekly police report, on Wednesday, a 19-year-old suspect from Madison was taken into custody for burglary and recklessly endangering safety after officers located him during an active incident.
Today's flavor of the day is the delicious Raspberry Cheesecake. Culver's is currently open and serving until 10:30 PM, so there is plenty of time to stop by for a scoop.
